measurementNotes: Shared desktop, not an isolated performance benchmark. Brief build/test/probe tasks overlapped some samples.
Peak RSS is the whole measurement Python process, including SQLite inspection, decoded states and evaluation. It is not the server-only RSS.
Exploration uses Runtime.start and unchanged default model/pruning. Scenario/horizon/red flip capability/profile are the only case-specific settings.
Specified-action cases restrict the chosen actions and enumerate their conflict outcomes only; they are not exhaustive strategy searches.
